name: harness-visualization
description: Учебный харнесс для ИИ-агентов с визуализацией потока данных

scripts.rag-index: pnpm --filter @harness-visualization/mcp-server... run build && cross-env NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 node packages/mcp-server/dist/mainRagIndex.js
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @harness-visualization/server... run build && pnpm --recursive run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @harness-visualization/server... run build && node --test packages/harness/dist/branch/branchModel.test.js packages/harness/dist/settings/modelRegistry.test.js packages/harness/dist/model/modelRegistryProvider.test.js packages/server/dist/sessions/modelSelection.test.js && pnpm --filter @harness-visualization/ui run test && node packages/harness/dist/cli/mainArena.js --verify
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run test
